prompt: Write the build/test guide for this repo.

message_includes: probe unavailable: the guide is unverified, so the floor will not use it for exclusion

rationale: Stable cargo has no JUnit/JSON (--format junit is nightly-only), so the skill must learn a text parser from libtest's own failures: summary, keep --exact out of the per-id deselect tokens, and say plainly that the probe is unavailable.
